items.title: Dermalogica Daily Microfoliant Review: Rice-Based Exfoliant, How to Use It
items.lead: Dermalogica Daily Microfoliant: an exfoliating powder for brighter, smoother skin every day, recommended for all skin types including skin with blemishes and blackheads.
items.hook: an exfoliating powder for brighter, smoother skin every day.
facts: Rice-based exfoliating powder, rich in AHAs, that activates on contact with water (13 g, 40 g, 74 g and 74 g refill)
Releases papain, salicylic acid and rice bran to polish skin; removes dulling surface debris and evens skin tone
Skin Brightening Complex of phytic acid from rice bran, white tea and licorice helps balance uneven skin tone
Colloidal oatmeal and allantoin help calm skin; gentle enough for daily use
Recommended for all skin types; listed for blemishes and blackheads, dullness, uneven texture and uneven skin tone
Use about a half-teaspoon in very wet hands, apply in circular motions avoiding the eyes, massage for one minute and rinse; adjust frequency if you experience irritation

scenes.caption: Daily Microfoliant
scenes.say: If you want brighter, smoother skin every day, this one is worth knowing. This is the Dermalogica Daily Microfoliant, an exfoliating powder, and in this video I'll go through what's in it, who it's for, and exactly how to use it.

scenes.caption: A rice-based powder
scenes.say: Daily Microfoliant is a rice-based powder, rich in alpha hydroxy acids. It stays a dry powder in the jar, and it activates when it touches water.

scenes.caption: Activates with water
scenes.say: Once it's activated, it releases papain, salicylic acid and rice bran to polish the skin.

scenes.caption: Papain, salicylic acid, rice bran
scenes.say: Those exfoliating ingredients remove dulling surface debris and even out skin tone, revealing brighter, smoother skin.

scenes.caption: Brightening complex
scenes.say: There's also a skin brightening complex. That's phytic acid from rice bran, plus white tea and licorice, and it helps balance uneven skin tone.

scenes.caption: Colloidal oatmeal and allantoin
scenes.say: To keep things comfortable, it has a super soothing blend of colloidal oatmeal and allantoin, which helps calm the skin.

scenes.caption: Gentle enough for daily use
scenes.say: And that's why it's called Daily Microfoliant. It's gentle enough for daily use.

scenes.caption: Blemishes and blackheads
scenes.say: It's recommended for all skin types. It's listed for blemishes and blackheads, for dullness, for uneven texture, and for uneven skin tone.

scenes.caption: Half a teaspoon
scenes.say: Here's how to use it. Dispense about half a teaspoon of the powder into very wet hands.

scenes.caption: Make a creamy paste
scenes.say: Rub your hands together to create a creamy paste.

scenes.caption: Circular motions
scenes.say: Apply it to your face in circular motions, avoiding the eye area. Massage gently for one minute, then rinse thoroughly.

scenes.caption: Toner, then moisturizer
scenes.say: Follow with Multi Active Toner or UltraCalming Mist, and then your Dermalogica moisturizer.

scenes.caption: If irritation happens
scenes.say: If you experience irritation, adjust how often you use it. Some people may notice a subtle scent, because botanical extracts and essential oils can have a natural scent.

scenes.caption: Sizes
scenes.say: Daily Microfoliant comes in thirteen gram, forty gram and seventy-four gram sizes, plus a seventy-four gram refill. To recap: a rice-based powder with papain, salicylic acid and rice bran, a brightening complex, and a soothing blend, gentle enough for every day. So that's the Dermalogica Daily Microfoliant. The link is in the description.

items.title: Dermalogica Daily Superfoliant Review: Binchotan Charcoal, How to Use It
items.lead: Dermalogica Daily Superfoliant: a resurfacing, anti-pollution powder exfoliant, best for normal, combination and oily skin.
facts: Highly active resurfacing, anti-pollution powder exfoliant (13 g, 57 g and 57 g refill)
Resurfaces and deep cleanses; adsorbs environmental pollutants and helps detoxify pores
Releases AHAs on contact with water; activated binchotan charcoal purifies the skin
Niacinamide, red algae and tara fruit extract help guard against pollution's effects
Best for normal, combination and oily skin; not ideal for very sensitive or compromised skin
Use about a half-teaspoon in very wet hands, apply in circular motions avoiding the eyes, massage for one minute and rinse with warm water; use daily, or on alternate days for more sensitive skin

scenes.caption: Daily Superfoliant
scenes.say: If your skin is normal, combination or oily, and you want a deep clean with your exfoliant, have a look at this. This is the Dermalogica Daily Superfoliant, a resurfacing, anti-pollution powder exfoliant.

scenes.caption: Resurfacing powder
scenes.say: Let's start with what it is. It's a highly active resurfacer, made to deliver your smoothest skin ever, and it helps fight environmental triggers known to speed up skin aging. It resurfaces and deep cleanses.

scenes.caption: Activated binchotan charcoal
scenes.say: Now let's look at what's inside. One of the key ingredients is activated binchotan charcoal, which purifies the skin.

scenes.caption: AHAs on contact with water
scenes.say: Like a powder exfoliant should, it releases alpha hydroxy acids when it touches water.

scenes.caption: Adsorbs pollutants
scenes.say: It adsorbs environmental pollutants and helps detoxify pores.

scenes.caption: Niacinamide
scenes.say: Next, there's a trio of ingredients aimed at pollution. It has niacinamide, red algae and tara fruit extract, and together they help guard against pollution's effects on your skin.

scenes.caption: Fights pollution triggers
scenes.say: It helps fight the pollution triggers that lead to premature skin aging.

scenes.caption: Normal, combination, oily
scenes.say: So who is it for? It's best for normal, combination and oily skin.

scenes.caption: Half a teaspoon
scenes.say: Here's how to use it. Dispense about half a teaspoon into very wet hands.

scenes.caption: Make a creamy paste
scenes.say: Rub your hands together to make a creamy paste.

scenes.caption: Circular motions
scenes.say: Apply it to your face in circular motions, avoiding the eye area. Massage gently for one minute, then rinse thoroughly with warm water.

scenes.caption: Use daily
scenes.say: It's made to be used daily, as part of your regular routine.

scenes.caption: For more sensitive skin
scenes.say: It's not ideal for very sensitive or compromised skin. Do a patch test, and use it less often if irritation happens. For more sensitive skin, use it on alternate days until your skin gets used to it.

scenes.caption: Sizes
scenes.say: Daily Superfoliant comes in a thirteen gram and a fifty-seven gram size, plus a fifty-seven gram refill. To recap: it's a resurfacing, anti-pollution powder with activated binchotan charcoal and niacinamide, for normal, combination and oily skin, used daily. So that's the Dermalogica Daily Superfoliant. The link is in the description.
